item.title: Planting required, 17th November
item.description:
Green Infrastructure Team - Request for replacement planting — Common land off Gloucester Road (A40), Benhall, Cheltenham* Good morning Chris, We are residents of 418 Gloucester Road, Benhall, and hope you can help. Recently you removed a dead tree and surrounding shrubs from the area of common land adjacent to our property on Gloucester Road. This has left a gap in the hedgerow which forms part of the vital A40 wildlife corridor between Benhall and Arle Court roundabouts. In addition to the loss of habitat and its appearance, the gap has reduced screening from the A40 and we have noticed an increase in litter collecting there. We would like to request that replacement native shrubbery be planted to restore the corridor and improve the appearance of this small section of common land. We believe this would align with the County Council's commitment to biodiversity and the "tree-friendly" approach taken for the West Cheltenham Transport Improvement Scheme. We would be very happy to help with watering / maintenance if that would assist. Many Thanks Keith Caldwell
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 406, Gloucester Road, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
